boards.title: 10 Late-Night Runs That Explain Santa Clara University
boards.description: Ten currently documented late-hour destinations in and around Santa Clara University, with access details kept conservative.

cards.title: University Library
cards.subtitle: Santa Clara University campus
cards.notes: Use the library’s posted standard-hours schedule to plan a study stop; confirm exceptions for breaks or exam periods before heading over.
cards.short_summary: A campus study destination with standard Monday–Thursday and Sunday hours extending to 2 a.m.
cards.evidence_claim: Santa Clara University lists standard library hours of 7 a.m.–2 a.m. Monday–Thursday and 9 a.m.–2 a.m. Sunday, with changes possible during breaks and exams.
cards.access_notes: Standard hours listed: Monday–Thursday 7 a.m.–2 a.m.; Sunday 9 a.m.–2 a.m. Hours may change during exam periods and breaks.

cards.entity_name: Pat Malley Fitness and Recreation Center
cards.title: Pat Malley Fitness and Recreation Center
cards.subtitle: Santa Clara University campus
cards.notes: Check the recreation center’s schedule before an evening workout and allow time to wrap up before the posted midnight closing window.
cards.short_summary: A campus recreation facility whose listed Monday–Thursday and Sunday hours run until midnight.
cards.evidence_claim: Santa Clara University lists Malley Recreation Center hours until midnight Monday–Thursday and Sunday.
cards.access_notes: Listed hours: Monday–Thursday 6:30 a.m.–midnight and Sunday 10 a.m.–midnight; verify changes before visiting.

cards.title: The Bronco
cards.subtitle: Benson Center, Santa Clara University
cards.notes: Look for Benson Center late-night programming if you want a campus gathering place with food and games; event offerings can vary.
cards.short_summary: The university identifies this Benson Center venue within its late-night food and entertainment programming.
cards.evidence_claim: Santa Clara University’s Late Night Programs page identifies The Bronco and describes late-night food, entertainment, free billiards, and foosball without a cover charge.
cards.source_title: Late Night Programs — Benson Center — Santa Clara University
cards.access_notes: SCU designates this as late-night programming; check the Benson Center page for the current program schedule before going.

cards.entity_name: Dae Bak Korean Fusion Eatery & Lounge
cards.title: Dae Bak Korean Fusion Eatery & Lounge
cards.subtitle: 3284 El Camino Real, Santa Clara
cards.notes: For a very late food stop, use the restaurant’s own ordering information and place an online order before its stated ordering cutoff.
cards.short_summary: A Santa Clara Korean-fusion restaurant that says it remains open until 2 a.m.
cards.evidence_claim: Dae Bak’s official website states that it is open until 2 a.m. and that online orders close at 11:30 p.m.
cards.source_title: Dae Bak Korean Fusion Eatery & Lounge
cards.access_notes: The business states it is open until 2 a.m.; online orders close at 11:30 p.m. Verify service details before travel.

cards.title: Giiwa
cards.subtitle: 1494 Halford Avenue, Santa Clara
cards.notes: Use the restaurant’s listed daily closing time as a late-evening checkpoint, and confirm seating or pickup availability directly before leaving campus.
cards.short_summary: A Santa Clara restaurant whose official site lists daily hours through 11:30 p.m.
cards.evidence_claim: Giiwa’s official website lists daily operating hours of 10 a.m. to 11:30 p.m. at 1494 Halford Avenue in Santa Clara.
cards.access_notes: Officially listed as open daily 10 a.m.–11:30 p.m.; confirm current kitchen, dine-in, and pickup availability before visiting.

cards.title: Taco Bell on The Alameda
cards.subtitle: 2555 The Alameda, Santa Clara
cards.notes: This location’s drive-through is the late-hours option; check the separate dine-in and drive-through schedules before setting out.
cards.short_summary: A The Alameda location with drive-through hours listed until 2 a.m. most nights and 3 a.m. Friday–Saturday.
cards.evidence_claim: Taco Bell lists drive-through hours until 2 a.m. Sunday–Thursday and until 3 a.m. Friday–Saturday at 2555 The Alameda.
cards.source_title: Taco Bell — 2555 The Alameda, Santa Clara
cards.access_notes: Drive-through: until 2 a.m. Sunday–Thursday and 3 a.m. Friday–Saturday. Listed dine-in hours end earlier, at 10 p.m.

cards.title: Taco Bell on El Camino Real
cards.subtitle: 1680 El Camino Real, Santa Clara
cards.notes: Use this El Camino Real location when drive-through access suits the plan; its posted dine-in hours end earlier than late service.
cards.short_summary: A Santa Clara drive-through location with posted service until 1 a.m. on weekdays and 3 a.m. Friday–Saturday.
cards.evidence_claim: Taco Bell lists drive-through hours until 1 a.m. Sunday–Thursday and 3 a.m. Friday–Saturday at 1680 El Camino Real.
cards.source_title: Taco Bell — 1680 El Camino Real, Santa Clara
cards.access_notes: Drive-through: until 1 a.m. Sunday–Thursday and 3 a.m. Friday–Saturday. Listed dine-in hours end at 9 p.m.

cards.title: Taco Bell on Homestead Road
cards.subtitle: 2600 Homestead Road, Santa Clara
cards.notes: Treat the drive-through schedule as the late option here, and check the location page for any same-day changes before the trip.
cards.short_summary: A Santa Clara drive-through location with posted late service until 2 a.m. most nights and 3:45 a.m. Friday–Saturday.
cards.evidence_claim: Taco Bell lists drive-through hours until 2 a.m. Sunday–Thursday and until 3:45 a.m. Friday–Saturday at 2600 Homestead Road.
cards.source_title: Taco Bell — 2600 Homestead Road, Santa Clara
cards.access_notes: Drive-through: until 2 a.m. Sunday–Thursday and 3:45 a.m. Friday–Saturday. Listed dine-in hours end at 10 p.m.

cards.title: Denny’s on El Camino Real
cards.subtitle: 1745 El Camino Real, Santa Clara
cards.notes: For an all-hours food stop, use the restaurant’s official location page and contact the location if you need holiday-specific confirmation.
cards.short_summary: A Santa Clara Denny’s location whose official page lists restaurant hours as open 24 hours.
cards.evidence_claim: Denny’s lists its restaurant at 1745 El Camino Real in Santa Clara as open 24 hours.
cards.source_title: Denny’s — 1745 El Camino Real, Santa Clara
cards.access_notes: Official location page lists restaurant hours as open 24 hours and advises contacting the restaurant to confirm holiday hours.

cards.entity_name: Jack in the Box — 3465 Homestead Road
cards.title: Jack in the Box on Homestead Road
cards.subtitle: 3465 Homestead Road, Santa Clara
cards.notes: Plan around the drive-through schedule rather than lobby hours, which the official location page lists as ending earlier in the evening.
cards.short_summary: A Homestead Road drive-through with posted service to 2 a.m. most nights and 3 a.m. Thursday–Saturday.
cards.evidence_claim: Jack in the Box lists drive-through hours at 3465 Homestead Road until 2 a.m. most nights and 3 a.m. Thursday through Saturday.
cards.source_title: Jack in the Box — 3465 Homestead Road, Santa Clara
cards.access_notes: Drive-through is listed until 2 a.m. most nights and 3 a.m. Thursday–Saturday; the lobby is listed until 10 p.m.
